summary: Live Oak Acquisition Corp. V, a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed a Form 8-K reporting its entry into Non-Redemption Agreements with unaffiliated holders of its Class A ordinary shares in connection with its pending business combination with Teamshares Inc. Under the agreements, NRA Investors agreed not to redeem an aggregate 276,646 shares at the June 16, 2026 extraordinary general meeting. In exchange, the sponsor will transfer to them 37,171 founder shares at closing. The mechanism reduces potential redemptions, thereby preserving trust proceeds for the deal. Close watch: shareholder vote outcome and any further sponsor support to ensure deal consummation.
